context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

The collector config validates and starts when I add a new contrib processor for production traffic, but the processor README says its stability is Alpha for the signal we need. Can I tell the customer this is safe because the YAML validates, or should I call out the stability level?

checklist.name: mentions-pin-test-upgrade
checklist.description: The response matches the pattern: (?i)(pin|pinned|version|staging|test|release notes|rollback)

checklist.name: alpha-production-risk
checklist.description: Explains that Alpha collector components are for limited non-critical workloads and may change configuration with little notice; they should not be presented as the default safe choice for business-critical production traffic.

checklist.name: validation-is-not-production-proof
checklist.description: States that `otelcol validate` or successful startup only proves the config parses/loads, not that the component is production-stable or upgrade-safe. A response that calls it safe solely because validation passes is a FAIL.
